comment: PROVISIONAL demo membership-application records for the Villa Memorial Plan
membership folio (FORMS_PLAN gap 4 / front-end F-18).
⚠️ No contract under docs/08-delivery/contracts/ names a membership / COC record: the
underwriter is a pre-need partner (Eternal Plans, Inc.) and the signed membership/COC
paper is NOT archived in this project (docs/07-client-villa/paper-forms/ holds only the
service contract and the two lot-purchase papers). These rows are demo data mirroring
the plan's own published shape (current-state-forms.md §5): holder · who the plan
protects from the client's own relationship list · branch · published tier × payment
mode · the declarations the paper carries. They carry NO COC number, no coverage
start/end dates and no clause wording — the app reproduces no document it has never
seen.
Each `rate_cents` is the published 2026 figure for that tier × term × rate class, read
from lib/fixtures/commerce/pricing.json (tests/fixture-contract/membership.test.ts pins
them to planRateOf); an office recording a new application reads the CURRENT pricing
document the same way. Rows persist through MEMBERSHIP_STORE_PATH (default
`.data/commerce-membership-applications.json`, gitignored) — never hand-edit this seed to
make a test pass.
Branch values are free text as the office writes them: the park's branch structure is an
open client question (docs/07-client-villa/open-questions.md), so no branch list is
invented here.
